name: Devil in My Arms
source:
“I will hurt you, angel.” Michael grits his teeth as my nails dig into his back.
But I don’t want gentle. I want to be corrupted. I want to be tainted with lust.
With our sin.
As our bodies move in synchrony, I know that I’m falling deeper and deeper for him.
And I don’t know how to stop it.”

A love story could begin anywhere, but for me, it started with lust.
When I met Michael at a nightclub, our chemistry was immediate, intense, and with no strings attached. We spent one night together before parting our ways.

But he turns out to be my new English professor, Prof. Michael Forster.

What was meant to be a casual hookup, turns into something more dangerous as we both give in to our desires and sharing a forbidden secret. In the eyes of society, we are teacher and student, but in truth, we are just two people lusting for each other... until that lust fades and become something more dangerous. Something that could destroy our fragile relationship.

That something is love.

[From [url=http://koyonplete.com/devil-in-my-arms/]official website[/url]]
translation:
“我要弄疼你，天使。”迈克尔咬紧牙关，我的指甲深深陷进他的背里。
可我不要温柔。我想堕落，想被欲望玷污，和我们的罪孽一起沉沦。
我们的身体同步起伏，我知道自己正越来越深地爱上他。
我不知道该如何停下。

爱情故事可以从任何地方开始，而我的故事始于欲望。
我在夜店遇见迈克尔，我们之间立刻擦出强烈火花，彼此没有任何承诺。一夜之后，我们各自离开。

然而，他竟成了我的新任英语教授——迈克尔·福斯特教授。

本来只是一场随性的邂逅，却随着我们屈服于欲望、分享禁忌秘密，变成更加危险的关系。在世人眼里，我们是师生；实际上，我们只是两个渴望彼此的人……直到欲望消退，演变成更危险的东西，足以摧毁我们脆弱的关系。

那就是爱情。
